theorems.name: Submission.dorwbl_test_fn_diff_quotient_integral_tendsto_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (v : Euclid n) (ψ : Euclid (n + k) → ℝ), Continuous f → DifferentiableAt ℝ f v → Continuous ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ R : ℝ, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ w in closedBall (0 : Euclid n) R, |ψ (ι w + ι' (r⁻¹ • (f (v + r • w) - f v))) - ψ (ι w + ι' (fderiv ℝ f v w))|) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
